## Objective

Deliver one coherent frontend for project explanation and permitted project reading.

## Scope

- Add the common navigation and independent app context
- Render project-owned Home explanations and next steps
- Render supporting reading views and traceable results

## Entry conditions

- Read response contracts and failure states are available.

## Exit criteria

- Home and all required destinations use shared navigation, safe rendering and truthful source/status information.

## Risks

- A frontend that still gates navigation on ontology context would fail core availability.

## TASK-008 - Add the common navigation and independent app context

Extend the existing TypeScript frontend with Project-app context and Home, Work, Project knowledge, Health and setup, Tools and help destinations plus visible Search. Keep the existing knowledge routes and use one shared frontend build.

| Dependencies | TASK-004, TASK-005, TASK-006, TASK-007 |
| Parallel group | None |

### Risks

- Keep the existing preferences harmless without adding a new theme/density feature.
- No dedicated assistive-technology or certification campaign is part of this task.

### Acceptance criteria

- App navigation boots from primary project context independently of ontology and preserves browser Back/Forward, Home return and legacy knowledge links.
- Missing modules have clear states; semantic controls, labels, focus and ordinary narrow-window/text-resize behavior keep essential content available.
- Existing safe DOM construction, lazy graph loading and current-request/version guards apply to added views.

### Planned verification

- Review route compatibility, request invalidation and labels in the changed code; use the one package build in TASK-013 and one browser session in TASK-018 for execution evidence.

## TASK-009 - Render project-owned Home explanations and next steps

Implement Home from the reviewed content contract and live bounded Work/Health results, including project purpose, scope, audience, Start here, available destinations, source links and recorded attention items.

| Parallel group | None |

### Risks

- Do not write default depot prose into a reusable starter or invent a generic purpose for every project.

### Acceptance criteria

- Home explains the selected project in concrete terms and links an appropriate documented first step, while incomplete source material remains an explicit gap.
- Custom explanatory text remains stable across load/refresh; source changes show review need and revoked source-derived content is withheld.
- Work/attention items retain record, actual issue/next step, source, observation and coverage states without invented urgency or scores.

### Planned verification

- Apply the communication skill to compare Home text, instructions and error effects with their exact supporting sources; use the alternate fixture and main browser session for behavior.

## TASK-010 - Render supporting reading views and traceable results

Integrate Work, Project knowledge and Lessons and decisions, typed search, Health and setup, and Tools and help into the shared navigation, reusing existing entry/process/source/map components and a readable relationship list.

### Risks

- Do not replace canonical work semantics with progress scores or treat remembered lessons as current definitions.

### Acceptance criteria

- A reader can follow explicit Work/requirement/plan/evidence references, search permitted material, inspect health and use accurate help without activating any owner mutation.
- Knowledge remains readable without graph rendering and displays meaningful relationship labels, direction, continuation and missing process details.
- Lessons remain labeled memory findings; status, source/version, observation time, historical gaps and optional failures retain their actual meanings.

### Planned verification

- Inspect source-to-display mappings and safe rendering in the integrated pages; cover representative supported flows in TASK-018 without testing every optional combination.
